title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle & vendoring for RKE2 + AlmaLinux 9 support
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private in regulated environments requested explicit RKE2 + AlmaLinux 9 support for the on-prem air-gapped installer. This PR adds an offline bundle variant vendored for RKE2 on AlmaLinux 9, updates the bundle generation pipeline to include RPM/EL repositories, and wire-ups for TUF metadata and signature verification.

Changes in this PR: vendored third-party container images (kube-proxy, calico, rke2 runtime bits) and Helm charts into the offline bundle; added RPM repository layout and metadata generation for AlmaLinux 9; extended the tuf-signer step to publish repo.json and timestamp files for offline verification; updated installer bootstrap to detect EL-based sysroots and surface a single toggle for "almalinux9" profiles; added smoke tests for RKE2+AlmaLinux 9 in the offline CI matrix.

Compatibility: The changes are additive — existing RKE2/Flatcar and Ubuntu bundles are unchanged except for shared tooling. The bundle creation scripts now accept a --distro flag and a --artifact-type to produce tar.xz offline bundles with the appropriate layout.

Testing & validation: Performed full onprem installer end-to-end validation in a VM lab: RKE2 1.27.x + AlmaLinux 9 minimal image, air-gapped install using local http mirror, TLS and TUF verification, KMS integration smoke (KMS not in airgap mode), and upgrade from 2025-09 installer bundle. Bundle size ~1.2GB compressed. Added CI matrix entry (airgap/almalinux9) which runs bundle-generation + smoke cluster start.

Operational notes: Documented the new distro profile in INSTALLER.md and added a troubleshooting subsection for common EL issues (selinux contexts, kernel module dependencies). Also included instructions for customers who manage a private yum mirror (yum-mirror setup example) and a small helper script to convert an apt mirror into a repo layout for mixed clusters.

Follow-ups: add dedicated RKE2 SELinux integration tests (ENG-4410) and a real-world upgrade-run with large stateful workloads (ENG-4411).

review_comments: Jonah Kim: Please add a short note in INSTALLER.md about kernel versions we validated (5.14+). Also can we avoid shipping debug images in the vendor bundle?
Aisha Patel: Removed debug images from vendor list and added kernel version note (5.14+). See commit b27d9f2.
Priya Singh: TUF metadata generation looks good, but the timestamp role was using an older expiry. Recommend 24h for timestamp and 7d for snapshot — adjust in tuf-config.
Aisha Patel: Updated tuf-config with 24h/7d expiry and added a short comment explaining the choices.
Marco de la Cruz: CI smoke job flaky on initial run (timeout while waiting for kubelet). Can we increase kubelet startup timeout and add logs on failure?
Aisha Patel: Increased startup timeout to 8m and captured journalctl output on failure. Flakiness stabilized in subsequent runs.
release_notes:
- Added official on-prem airgap offline bundle variant for RKE2 on AlmaLinux 9.
- Vendored RKE2 runtime images and Helm charts into the offline bundle.
- TUF metadata and RPM repodata generation for EL-based distributions.
- Installer profile for 'almalinux9' with docs and troubleshooting notes.
notes_for_support: Bundle is ~1.2GB compressed. Customers using older RKE2 (<=1.26) should pin the installer to the legacy bundle (see docs). If SELinux denials occur, recommend running the selinux troubleshooting steps in INSTALLER.md. For private mirror setup, use the provided repodata generation script.
backout_plan: If regressions are reported, revert the bundle-generator --distro flag and restore previous default bundle pipeline; maintainers can redeploy previous release bundle from artifacts/releases/<tag> and rollback installer helm release using 'helm rollback redwood-installer <rev>'.
